author: Erica
reviewTitle: Lovely apt in center of Mtskheta
reviewText:
Понравилось: The location is perfect if you want to stay in Mtskheta. Very nice little apartment with all you need for a short stay, and most of what you might need for a longer one. Laundry, small kitchen, fridge, AC, and room for 3 or maybe 4 to sleep (I think the couch pulls out), but there were only 2 of us. The bed is not the most comfortable I've slept in, but it was fine for a night. Street parking was no problem, once we figured out getting into the old city area. Good value for this lodging.

Не понравилось: The apt itself is great. The reason I'm deducting a star is that the communication was less than ideal. The hosts were very friendly and helpful, but didn't speak English, which would be fine if I had been given more info up front, like being sent an info email or message the day before arrival. We were in touch prior, and they responded promptly, but info was left out which would've been helpful beforehand considering i did tell them in advance we had no phone service in Georgia. 

For example, they said to use a map to find the place, which left out the important info that we'd need a remote control to get into the old city, so we drove to 3 gates before figuring out that one of us would wait by the car and the other would walk in. Then I couldn't find anyone at the building, nor figure out how to open the front gate, and had to ask a nearby vendor to help me call. When someone arrived, he was very nice, but the language barrier was a bit of an issue for me to ask questions; to get wifi, how to park, etc. Eventually, he put me on the phone with someone else who spoke good English, and everything got sorted, but it definitely took us an extra 30-45 min to check in after all this. 

Long story short, I would indeed recommend this place, and would stay again, however I also recommend confirming all info beforehand.

reviewTitle: Just wonderful, but a few small things could be improved
reviewText:

Waking up in the morning and walking out to that absolutely beautiful cathedral with the swallows flying everywhere, the shops opening up...just amazing, a wonderful experience. It was also nice to have good air conditioning.
The manager is very nice and communication was easy.
Suggestion: Reserve a table by the water at Ada Café for dinner

Не понравилось: The apartment is slightly below ground so there is not much natural light and the WIFI is not super (which is why it may not be great for someone on business). 
It is a shame that there is no table to eat, just a low coffee table in the living room. I would suggest replacing the sofa at the entry which is not very useful with a table and a few chairs. 
The bed was too soft and flimsy for our liking, but that is personal. 
Finally, driving into the town with the barriers is not easy. I probably should have looked closer at other comments. There is no code to enter at the barrier where we arrived. You have to find a place to park, and then get the remote control from the manager. Luckily we did find a way despite Google Maps not being able to figure out the location (right at the main T intersection).

author: Ekaterina
reviewText:

Жилье прекрасное, чисто, всё необходимое есть. Ночевали 1 ночь, ничем не успели воспользоваться, но впечатления остались самые приятные. Встречали с бутылочкой домашнего вина, это было очень приятно после долгой дороги. Чисто. Есть все ванные принадлежности вплоть до одноразовых тапочек. Рекомендую, цена соответствует месту, даже занижена, на мой взгляд

Не понравилось: Были сложности с заездом: приехали примерно с 21, в это время город будто вымер, вывески нет, хозяев не было, блудили кругами, было страшновато остаться без жилья ночью ещё и без связи, местных денег (только заехали в страну). Но потом прохожий позвал откуда-то хозяев и все разрешилось. Больше минусов не было, все понравилось

author: Nuflo
reviewText:

Не понравилось: La verdad es que no hay nada que no me haya gustado!

author: Stepan
reviewText: Понравилось: Отличные апартаменты, все есть. Очень чисто и уютно. Находятся прямо в центре рядом с достопримечательностями.

author: Alejandro
reviewText:

Не понравилось: Nada, todo perfecto

reviewText:

author: მიკხაილო
reviewText:

author: Aleksei
reviewText:

author: Alexandr
reviewText: Понравилось: Прекрасное расположение вблизи достопримечательностей. Пришлось правда, поискать немного  ( навигатор как всегда искал кратчайший путь). Спасибо большое владельцам за создание прекрасных домашних условий. Всё продумано до мелочей! Чай, кофе, вода, стиральный порошок - вообщем , все для комфортного проживания.  Ребята очень милые, готовые помочь при необходимости.  Очень надеюсь, что ещё не раз смогу побывать в доме этих замечательных и гостеприимных людей!
